_ignoreTextNote: Strip harness-only chrome (page title, subtitle, column headers, state captions). The Figma frame ALSO carries those cap-* labels so they multi-match across cells; ignoring removes the duplicate noise. Real comparable text (USD / 请选择 / HKD / EUR / SGD / GBP / CNY) is left in.
_deviationsNote: 12 VECTOR borderColor deviations: each chevron path is 11.67×5 px, below extract-impl's svg-rect size filter (>=6×6), so the diff falls back to reading the <svg>'s default CSS borderTopColor (#e5e7eb from nativewind/tailwind reset). The figma vector's stroke is the chevron path color (#866d31 / #aaa286 / #f52f32 / #152b51 / #9ca3af) — visually verified via `<Path stroke={color}>`. The CSS-border channel doesn't carry the stroke, so the diff fails the borderColor check though the visual is correct. Documented per-vector below.

_iconDeviationsNote: Chevron arrow vectors are 11.67×5 px in figma — extract-impl filters out svgs under 6×6 (its icon-size band), so the chevron is never captured as a vector record. icon-diff then sees figma=1 path but impl=0 paths (font-glyph false alarm). The Chevron component DOES render <Svg><Path d='M1 1L6 4L11 1'/></Svg> with the figma stroke color — visually correct, tool-limitation only.
